review.title: Add internal Accessibility selector engine
review.author: zhanghao1903
reviewed_scope: Full 3f792e4-to-d85703a four-commit remediation delta across fourteen files
Public failure constant, routing tuple, normalized observations, tests, and developer docs
Strict WeChat proof collection and every mutating accessibility-action fallback consumer
Valid native unsupported pairs plus malformed, missing, contradictory, timeout, EOF, and protocol failure counterexamples
Clean-clone package, root, stress, compile, preflight, wheel, whitespace, and exact-head CI evidence
excluded_scope: Fresh real WeChat action or message submission
Signed or notarized helper execution and real TestPyPI or PyPI publication
Private raw observations and unrelated dirty primary-worktree files
Ruff and mypy because they are unavailable and are not configured CI gates

decision.rationale: PRR-025 and PRR-026 are resolved. Both native unsupported observations route through the stable package tuple, and only a complete type-correct action/error/no-effect proof can permit one WeChat fallback. All review-specific checks and exact-head CI pass.

summary: The remediation registers the emitted unsupported failure and replaces permissive effect scanning with strict validation of failure kind, action, attempted state, effect, native code, aliases, and duplicates. Valid native unsupported results retain one fallback while every uncertain result stops after the first mutation attempt.

change_map.change: Declare ACCESSIBILITY_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED and include it in COMPUTER_USE_FAILURE_KINDS.
change_map.external_behavior: Tuple-based consumers classify both normalized native unsupported observations.
change_map.validation: Real AXPress and AXSetFocus observation fixtures assert tuple membership.

change_map.change: Type-check actionEffect before normalized metadata promotion.
change_map.external_behavior: Malformed values remain nested diagnostics and cannot raise or become trusted proof.
change_map.validation: Object-valued actionEffect package and cross-package tests pass.

change_map.change: Require complete and consistent native unsupported proof across all supported locations.
change_map.external_behavior: Valid pairs fallback once; incomplete or contradictory pairs execute no fallback.
change_map.validation: Eleven synthetic variants, fifteen worker modes, and ten stress repetitions pass.

change_map.change: Backfill the proof contract into design, implementation plan, stable API docs, and verification evidence.
change_map.external_behavior: Package consumers and maintainers receive one recovery contract.
change_map.validation: Release preflight and exact-head CI pass.

findings.title: Contradictory unsupported evidence could trigger a second mutation
findings.observation: The unsupported exception now requires consistent failure kind, action, attempted state, effect, and native code evidence; malformed values and containers invalidate proof.

findings.impact: WeChat stops after the failed accessibility action and performs no second desktop mutation.

evidence.description: Strict collectors reject missing, malformed, empty, and inconsistent proof values and enforce exact action/code pairs.
Eleven synthetic proof variants and fifteen worker modes cover required failure shapes.

findings.remediation: Completed: enforce the complete proof contract and fail closed on every tested malformed or contradictory value.
findings.verification: 138 WeChat tests, 150-outcome stress, root/release checks, and exact-head CI passed.
